Mei Jih I-Pao ("News Digest"): 29 JUNE 1938 PM
BRITISH AMBASSADOR LEAVING FOR HANKOW

At the request of the Chinese Government, Sir
Archibald Clark Kerr, British Ambassador to China, left
Shanghai yesterday morning for Hongkong on board the
s.s. Empress of Russia en route to Hankow. Sir
Archibald is accompanied by about ten foreign experts whom
he had collected in Shanghai for the purpose of helping
China in her war-time finance and expanding the scope
of Great Britain's assistance to China.
The British Ambassador is in deep sympathy
with China's war of resistance and is highly disgusted with
Japan's acts of aggression and her violation of British
interests.
In view of Japan's aggressive policy, Great
Britain has found it impossible to reach a compromise
with her; she has therefore decided to give China positive
financial assistance.

（批：Taken
Seen by Mr Robertson
R 3/7）

《每日译报》（"News Digest"）：1938年6月29日下午
英国大使启程前往汉口

应中国政府请求，英国驻华大使阿奇博尔德·克拉克·克尔爵士（Sir Archibald Clark Kerr）于昨晨乘“俄罗斯皇后”号轮船（s.s. Empress of Russia）离开上海前往香港，途中转往汉口。陪同阿奇博尔德爵士的约有十名外国专家，这些专家是他在上海召集的，旨在协助中国的战时财政并扩大英国对华援助的范围。
英国大使对中国的抗战深表同情，并对日本的侵略行径及其侵犯英国利益的行为感到极为愤慨。
鉴于日本的侵略政策，英国发现已不可能与其达成妥协；因此，英国决定向中国提供积极的财政援助。

（批注：已取阅
罗伯逊先生阅

June 27, 1938.

MAINICHI :-

FRANCE DEFINITELY SUPPORTS CHINA

The Chiang Kai-shek regime has
authority over five provinces only, namely Yunnan,
Kweichow, Szechuen, Kwangtung and Kwangsi. The
activities of the Ambassadors and Ministers of Third
Powers in China are worthy of attention among which
the French Ambassador's draw special attention. Recently
the French Ambassador paid a visit to Hanoi where he met
the Governor-General of Indo-China and decided to support
China in the following ways:-
(1) By constructing the Nanning-
Chinnangkwan Railway.
(2) By extending the Yunnan-Hanoi
Railway to Szechuen.
(3) To give financial assistance in
building motor roads between Yunnan and Kwangtung as
well as between Yunnan and Burma.
(4) By forming an economic bloc with
Yunnan, Kweichow, Szechuen, Kwangsi and Indo-China.
(5) By establishing a heavy industrial
district at Tongking.
(6) By supplying military advisors
to China.

BRITISH AMBASSADOR TO VISIT HANKOW

As a result of the continuous defeat
of the Chinese Army and diminished financial support of
the Hankow Government, the Powers are about to change
their diplomatic policy.
Acting on instructions from London,
Sir Archibald Clark Kerr, British Ambassador, will
proceed to Hankow via Hongkong on June 28 on a secret
mission. According to reliable information, he will
attempt to put an end to the Sino-Japanese hostilities.
It is now known what conditions will be proposed to
Chiang Kai-shek by the Ambassador.
With the understanding of America,
Britain will decide her attitude after she has obtained
Japan's views. For this reason, the Ambassador will
probably propose the retirement of Chiang Kai-shek and
the introduction of a new currency in Central China in
co-operation with Japan. Upon learning of the above
news, the Soviet Ambassador to China left for Moscow on
June 23 to draw up a suitable policy to be adopted towards
the new situation.
As regards the return of the German
Ambassador the following explanation was given: "Due to
the fact that the German Ambassador has not attempted to do
anything and has allowed Britain to take advantage of the
situation in China even though it is clear that the fall
of the Hankow Government is approaching, he will be
replaced by a new Ambassador."

1938年6月27日。

《每日新闻》（MAINICHI）：

法国明确支持中国

蒋介石政权仅管辖五个省份，即云南、贵州、四川、广东和广西。各国驻华大使及公使的活动值得关注，其中法国大使尤为引人注目。近日，法国大使访问了河内，会见了印度支那总督，并决定通过以下方式支持中国：
(1) 修建南宁至镇南关铁路。
(2) 将滇越铁路延伸至四川。
(3) 为修建云南与广东之间以及云南与缅甸之间的公路提供财政援助。
(4) 与云南、贵州、四川、广西及印度支那组成经济集团。
(5) 在东京（Tonkin，即越南北部）建立重工业区。
(6) 向中国派遣军事顾问。

英国大使将访问汉口

由于中国军队连续战败以及汉口政府获得的财政支持减少，列强即将改变其外交政策。
奉伦敦指示，英国大使阿奇博尔德·克拉克·爵士将于6月28日经香港前往汉口执行秘密任务。据可靠消息，他将试图结束中日敌对状态。目前尚不清楚大使将向蒋介石提出何种条件。
在美国的谅解下，英国将在获悉日本的意见后决定其态度。为此，大使可能会提议蒋介石下野，并与日本合作在华中地区发行新货币。获悉上述消息后，苏联驻华大使于6月23日启程前往莫斯科，以制定适应新形势的适当政策。
关于德国大使返任一事，有以下解释：“鉴于德国大使未采取任何行动，且尽管汉口政府垮台在即已显而易见，却仍任由英国利用中国局势，他将被新任大使取代。”
